featured_reviews.name: Surya Gounder
featured_reviews.review_text:
recently had the misfortune of dealing with Oriental Insurance Company, and I can honestly say it was one of the worst customer service experiences I have ever had. From start to finish, the entire process was marred by rude, unprofessional employees and a lack of accountability.

First of all, the staff members I interacted with were not only unhelpful but downright disrespectful. Whenever I called with inquiries about my policy, I was met with impatience and snarky responses. It was as if I was inconveniencing them simply by asking for assistance. On top of that, every time I asked for clarification, I was brushed off or given vague, confusing answers, making it clear they had no interest in resolving any issues.

The incompetence didn’t stop there. When I had to file a claim, the process was excruciatingly slow, and I was continuously given the runaround. It seemed like no one took any responsibility, and everyone I spoke to passed the blame to someone else. There was a complete lack of follow-up, and it felt like I was constantly chasing after them to get even the most basic information.

But perhaps what truly stood out in my dealings with Oriental Insurance was the sheer laziness and unethical behavior I encountered. Several employees I spoke to seemed entirely uninterested in helping or even doing their jobs properly. I had to repeatedly call and email to get the most basic updates about my claim, and on multiple occasions, I was promised callbacks or emails that never came. They seemed to be actively avoiding their responsibilities, and I couldn’t help but feel like they were intentionally delaying the process to frustrate me into abandoning my claim.

What I find most upsetting is how easily they dismissed my concerns. There was no apology for the delay or lack of communication; no recognition of the fact that I had been inconvenienced by their inefficiency. The company’s complete disregard for customer satisfaction and their lack of transparency only made the situation worse. I have never encountered such unethical and lazy behavior from any company before.

In conclusion, I highly recommend staying away from Oriental Insurance Company. If you value professionalism, respect, and efficiency, look elsewhere. Their rude employees and unethical business practices make them a company I would never trust with my insurance needs again. If I could rate them lower than one star, I would. Do yourself a favor and avoid this company at all costs.

featured_reviews.name: Shailendra Mishra
featured_reviews.review_text:
25th April 2025:
Extremely disappointing experience with Magma General Insurance.

Despite submitting all required documents for policy endorsement after vehicle ownership transfer, the company has been unnecessarily delaying and refusing to process the endorsement, citing contradictory and illogical reasons.

On one hand, they are not honouring the claim stating the policy was not endorsed, and on the other hand, they are refusing to endorse the policy even after claim closure, creating a completely unavoidable situation for the customer and putting customer on a very high risk.

This is not just poor service it reflects a lack of accountability and basic understanding of customer risk. Because of their inaction, the policy remains in the previous owner’s name, exposing the current owner to serious complications in case of any future claims, including third-party liabilities.
Multiple follow-ups emails only result in template responses with no resolution or ownership.

I strongly advise potential customers to think twice or thrice before choosing this insurer, especially if you expect timely support or basic administrative services like policy endorsement and cooperation from the Insurer. There employees do wrongful commitments. One surveyer said he will turn-up by EOD to survey the vehicle, two days later I had call him to take the status. Every alternate day I had to follow up for the status though there was no status. There is  NOT a single instance where the surveyor has called me and provided the status of which I followed with him. They have a 15 days TAT to process the request of claim, today it's been like 23rd days, no resolution either on claim or endorsement which keep the customer on a very high risk and it is a complete disappointment. There GRO is also not effective and customer centric but having template response and provide illogical reasons for delay which cannot be a accepted by a person with rationale mind.

A company that cannot handle a simple endorsement request raises serious concerns about how they would handle critical claims. Choose responsible insurer who might be a bit costlier than this insurer but they will give you peace of mind and NOT the chaos that Magma General Insurance does to its customers.

I am in the process of escalating this matter before the right forum as such deliberate careless or reckless bahavior of the Magma General Insurance cannot be tolerated.

#PoorService #BoycottMagmaGeneralInsurance
#IRDAI
#CIOINS

For privacy reasons, I won’t share personal contact details publicly. Please reach out to me via direct message or email so I can share details securely. Else, you may get my contact details from your customer support team or GRO Team.

29th Apr 2026: It's been 5 days the review has been written here, except an incorrect template response, no concrete information received regarding this. The Magma and it's GRO team is still taking whole lot unreasonable time for the completing the endorsement process of the vehicle. Please note that Magma got the vehicle inspected on 25 April 2026 as per my tough conversation with GRO team and inspection report shared with me on 28th April 2026 with requisition of some documents which I have provided to Magma and it's GRO on 28th April 2026 on which Magma has replied that they will update in next 2 days. Also, note that the Magma's GRO stated on 24th April 2026 that the claim will be closed by 27th April 2026 which I have sought the update that they have not provided to me the update yet. It is interesting that for the first time Magma's surveyor contacted me, he sent an email asking documents for the claim processing on 26th April 2026 and in the email he has stated that he got the survey done of the vehicle at the service centre which in reality he never turned on till the time my vehicle was there that day.
